idleSub: Jump to grab the good ones and over the bad ones.
pausedSub: Click or press Enter to keep running.
editingSub: The game is paused while you edit.
emptySub: Add some content to this game to make it playable.
copyNote: Copied. Paste it where you need it.
copyFail: The text is selected. Copy it with Ctrl or Cmd + C.
stageLabel: Runner game. The character runs by itself. Jump to grab good concepts and avoid bad ones.
stageHow: Press Space, Enter, the up arrow or W to jump. Press Escape to pause. Press Tab to move on. Everything in the game is also listed under Read it without playing.
hintKeys: Space, up arrow or W to jump
guideText: Grab what is part of the web component specification. Jump over what is not native web.
